avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra (Ma Huang)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic activity antagonizes beta-blocker effects; risk of hypertensive crisis and tachycardia

avoid_supplements.name: Phenylephrine supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct alpha-adrenergic agonist opposes propranolol's vasodilatory effects; severe hypertension risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid all decongestant supplements containing phenylephrine

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-2 adrenergic antagonist increases sympathetic activity opposing beta-blockade
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; monitor for hypertension and tachycardia if inadvertently combined

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Stimulant properties and potential sympathomimetic effects may reduce antihypertensive efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose preparations; if used, monitor BP regularly

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mineralocorticoid effects may cause sodium/fluid retention and potassium loss, blunting antihypertensive effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and electrolytes; limit duration and dose

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive cardiac effects and potential for enhanced beta-blockade; mild hypotension risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure; may require dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Excessive supplementation may potentiate hypotensive effects
caution_supplements.action: Limit to RDA (320-420 mg/day); monitor for hypotension symptoms

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium foods (chronic excessive intake)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Sodium retention reduces antihypertensive efficacy of propranolol
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on DASH diet; maintain sodium <2300 mg/day

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages and foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Sympathomimetic effects may mildly reduce beta-blocker efficacy and cause tachycardia or tremor
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake to <200 mg/day; monitor for increased heart rate or anxiety

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase propranolol absorption variability, potentially affecting steady-state levels
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent meal timing and fat intake for stable drug levels

caution_foods.name: Chocolate (high-dose consumption)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains caffeine and phenylethylamine with mild stimulant properties
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate amounts; counsel on total daily caffeine intake

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and exercise tolerance regularly as sympathomimetic supplements and excessive caffeine may reduce therapeutic efficacy. Assess for hypotension, fatigue, and bradycardia, especially if dietary sodium or stimulant intake changes; counsel on consistent meal composition and timing for stable propranolol bioavailability.
